sentences.text: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease axonal type 2V is linked to the gene NAGLU in curated databases [e_2734b3a5f5c8].
Dermatoleukodystrophy has no gene listed in these edges [e_a7feafdad1c8].
For dermatoleukodystrophy, thickened skin and an excess of horny skin are listed as curated, very frequent features [e_83a7fab381f2] [e_a7feafdad1c8].
Constellate computed a very weak similarity between the two diseases in their listed symptoms, with a score of 0.091 [e_8656c7454794].
That score is inferred, and the two diseases share 0 listed symptom terms [e_8656c7454794].
So these edges do not support calling the two diseases related [e_8656c7454794].
They also show no trials, funding or patient groups for either disease [e_2734b3a5f5c8].
